text: Human Rights Watch reports that in 2026 Bahraini authorities arbitrarily arrested dozens of people; one detainee died in custody after being disappeared, and twelve death row inmates remain at imminent risk of execution.
short: HRW documents 2026 Bahrain arrests, a custody death, imminent execution risk

source.name: Human Rights Watch - Bahrain country page
source.quote: Twelve death row inmates remain at imminent risk of execution.
